title: AURA-VERIFIER — Independent CLI and Browser Verifier (v1.1.0)
description: Independent open-source verifier for AURA evidence packages. Version 1.1.0 validates the optional signed TDM rights-reservation profile in both Node and browser engines, rejects non-boolean declarations and tampering, and reports syntax, signature and asset binding separately from issuer authority, discovery or receipt, and legal effect. Local verification remains available with network access blocked and no account or proprietary backend.
